watchdog.page_description: Automatically detect and recover from internet outages with escalating recovery steps.
watchdog.settings_description: Configure connection health monitoring and recovery.
watchdog.auto_disabled_alert: Watchdog disabled itself after too many reboots in one hour. Re-enable it below once your connection is stable.
watchdog.failure_threshold_description: How many failed probes in a row count as down before recovery begins.
watchdog.probe_interval_description: How often the modem checks the internet. Shared with Connection Quality.
watchdog.probe_interval_tooltip: Recovery reacts to the connectivity check run at this interval. Picking a profile sets the same sensitivity as the Connection Quality page; Custom overrides it with your own interval.
watchdog.probe_interval_more_info_aria: More information about the probe interval
watchdog.declares_down_preview: Declares the connection down after about {{secs}}s.
watchdog.declares_down_unknown: Set a probe interval and failure threshold to see the detection time.
watchdog.cooldown_description: Wait time after each recovery step before checking connectivity again.
watchdog.max_reboots_description: How many device reboots are allowed per hour before the watchdog locks itself.
watchdog.tier_1_description: Asks the modem to reconnect to your carrier's network. The gentlest first step.
watchdog.tier_2_description: Turns the modem's radio off and back on to force a fresh connection to the tower.
watchdog.tier_3_description: Switches to your backup SIM when the primary SIM can't get back online.
watchdog.tier_4_description: Restarts the whole device. Used only as a last resort when nothing else works.
watchdog.backup_sim_description: Which SIM slot to fail over to when Tier 3 activates.
watchdog.backup_sim_required_error: Choose a backup SIM slot or disable Tier 3.
watchdog.tier_2_tooltip: Automatically skipped when tower lock is active to preserve your locked cells.
watchdog.toast_sim_revert_success: SIM revert requested. The watchdog will process this shortly.
watchdog.status_starting: Watchdog is starting up. It will begin monitoring shortly.
watchdog.status_sim_failover_message: Running on backup SIM (slot {{current_slot}}) since {{switched_at}}. Original SIM was in slot {{original_slot}}.
watchdog.status_sim_revert_dialog_description: This will switch back to SIM slot {{original_slot}}. Your internet will briefly disconnect while the modem reconnects.
watchdog.quality_more_info_aria: More information about connection quality recovery
watchdog.quality_tooltip: Latency and loss are read as windowed averages and compared to the thresholds you set on the Connection Quality page. A breach must persist for the set number of consecutive samples before recovery runs.
watchdog.quality_thresholds_readonly_title: Recovery acts on your quality thresholds
watchdog.quality_thresholds_shared_note: Set on the Connection Quality page. The same thresholds also fire Recent Activities events.
watchdog.quality_consecutive_description: How many degraded samples in a row before recovery runs.
watchdog.quality_consecutive_error: Must be a number between 1 and 60.
watchdog.overview_description: Live connection health and the recovery actions taken.
watchdog.quality_off_hint: Off — recovery triggers on reachability only.
watchdog.state_off_subtitle: Turn it on to monitor connection health and auto-recover.
watchdog.state_blurb_suspect: A check just failed. Confirming before acting.
watchdog.state_blurb_recovery: Running a recovery step to restore the connection.
watchdog.state_blurb_cooldown: Waiting to see if the last step worked.
watchdog.state_blurb_ssr_hold: The modem is restarting its radio firmware. Holding off recovery so it can heal on its own.
watchdog.ssr_aware_description: When the modem briefly restarts its own radio firmware, let it heal before any recovery step runs.
watchdog.ssr_aware_tooltip: Some modems briefly restart their radio firmware and recover on their own within seconds. When that's detected, the watchdog waits instead of forcing a reconnect on top, which can make the outage longer. If the connection still hasn't returned after the grace window, the recovery steps run as usual.
watchdog.ssr_aware_more_info_aria: More information about waiting out radio self-recovery
watchdog.ssr_grace_description: How long to let the modem self-recover before the recovery steps may act.
watchdog.ssr_grace_error: Must be a number between 10 and 120.
watchdog.primary_recheck_description: Periodically switch back to the primary SIM to check whether it's healthy again, and return to it automatically when it is.
watchdog.primary_recheck_tooltip: The modem can only use one SIM at a time, so the only way to know if your primary SIM is working again is to switch back and test it. Each check briefly interrupts the connection — if the primary is still down, the watchdog returns to the backup SIM. Leave this off if you'd rather switch back manually.
watchdog.primary_recheck_more_info_aria: More information about auto fail-back to the primary SIM
watchdog.primary_recheck_interval_description: How often to test the primary SIM while running on the backup. Each check briefly interrupts the connection.
watchdog.primary_recheck_interval_error: Must be a number between 5 and 1440.
watchdog.tab_has_errors_aria: This tab has fields that need attention
watchdog.quality_on_hint: On — recovery also runs when latency or packet loss stays over your thresholds.
watchdog.save_fix_errors_in: Fix the highlighted fields in {{tabs}} before saving.
watchdog.activity_description: Recovery attempts and SIM failovers the watchdog has logged.
watchdog.activity_empty_message: When the watchdog runs a recovery step or fails over to a backup SIM, it will show up here.

latency.page_description: Monitor and analyze latency and packet loss to identify potential issues and optimize performance.
latency.card_description: Realtime ping results plus hourly, 12-hour, and daily averages.
latency.view_info_realtime: Real-time ping results from the last 50 seconds. Each bar represents a single ping.
latency.view_info_hourly: Hourly averages of latency and packet loss over the last 24 hours.
latency.view_info_12hour: 12-hour period averages of latency and packet loss.
latency.view_info_daily: Daily averages of latency and packet loss.
latency.entries_description: Raw ping measurements for the selected timeframe.
latency.entries_empty: No ping entries available for this timeframe.
